**Reject existing non-object configuration files before saving.**

For an existing array, string, number, boolean, or `null` config, `app::read` succeeds and `/config` opens. A row edit reaches `staged`, replaces the root with `{}`, adds the edited row, and `app::write` replaces the complete file. The original JSON is discarded while the UI reports a normal save.

Keep the empty-object normalization for a missing file, but reject an existing non-object file both when opening `/config` and when rereading during save.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-        let doc = match app::read(repo) {
-            Ok((_, doc)) => doc,
+        let (path, doc) = match app::read(repo) {
+            Ok((path, doc)) if doc.is_object() || !path.exists() => (path, doc),
+            Ok((path, _)) => {
+                return self.notice(
+                    &format!("{}: config must be a JSON object", path.display()),
+                    NOTICE_WINDOW,
+                )
+            }
             Err(err) => return self.notice(&err, NOTICE_WINDOW),
         };
```

```diff
     let (path, read) = app::read(repo)?;
     let mut doc = read.clone();
     if !doc.is_object() {
+        if path.exists() {
+            return Err(format!("{}: config must be a JSON object", path.display()));
+        }

```

Fixed in 6b803a6: a new `app::read_object` treats a missing (or `null`) config.json as an empty object and refuses any other non-object with "<path>: not a JSON object". `/config` open, its save-time reread (`staged`) and `set_typesafe` all use it, so the file is left as it was instead of being replaced with `{}`. Test: `a_config_json_not_an_object_is_refused_not_replaced`.

src/orchestrator/app.rs (1)
`315-316`: _🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Write `set_typesafe` through `app::write`.** `set_typesafe` now reads `config.json` through `read_object`. It still writes the file in place with `fs::write` (Line 318). The new `write` helper writes to a temp file and then renames it, so a Stage that reads `config.json` as it starts never sees a half-written file. `typesafe()` reads the same file when a Debate starts. Use the helper here so that every writer of `config.json` replaces the file atomically.
♻️ Proposed change ```diff let (path, mut doc) = read_object(repo)?; doc["typesafe"] = Value::Bool(on); - fs::create_dir_all(path.parent().unwrap()) - .and_then(|()| fs::write(&path, format!("{doc:#}\n"))) - .map_err(|err| format!("{}: {err}", path.display())) + write(&path, &doc) ```
Based on learnings: "When code writes shared state files … that other processes read concurrently, flag non-atomic writes … Prefer write-to-temp-file-then-rename."
